#0010admin-finance

Admin & Finance

owneradmin
module-rootadmin-financemounted: truenoneAdmin close-out

Owner/admin hub with an overview of cards and a sub-view switcher: lead inbox/qualify, assignment board, close-out queue, payments, price sheets, time-off/blackouts, planning, reports, employees. Buttons: Add Job, Plan, Add Blackout.

Central admin and finance module root for owners and admins to triage leads, assign jobs, close out work, and manage payments, pricing and time off.

How to identify when editing

Claims
M5: Source has a TODO(forward contract) near line 708: no per-actor CompensationPolicy repository/field, so close-out compensation is not fully wired. Screen is read-only for job stage.

Job Create Screen

owneradmin
sub-viewadmin-financemounted: falseNOT MOUNTEDnewAdmin close-out

Admin form to create a new job: text fields for address, description and scheduled start, with "Cancel" and "Create job" buttons. Shows a sign-in empty state if there is no session.

Lets an owner or admin manually enter a new job (address required) and save it through the job repository.

#0016af-assignmentBoard

Assignments

owneradmin
sub-viewadmin-financemounted: truescheduledAdmin close-out

Admin board of qualified/scheduled jobs: unassigned pool plus tech columns. Pick a visit kind (Service/Prem), choose a tech via Select, tap Confirm; a WarningSheet shows warn-only warnings. Category filter chips. Action buttons are G1 sand buttons. A Soonest/Newest sort segment row (default Soonest) orders the pool: unassigned jobs first, assigned jobs dimmed and last. Tap a job opens #0041.

Lets owners/admins assign qualified or scheduled jobs to active techs, with warn-only conflict warnings before confirming.

#0052af-leadCreate

New Lead

owneradmin
sub-viewadmin-financemounted: truenewAdmin close-out

Owner/admin form titled New Lead: text fields for name, phone, email, service, preferred date (YYYY-MM-DD), time, address, project details; buttons Cancel and Create lead. Shows sign-in prompt if no session.

Lets an admin manually enter a new lead into the intake pipeline via the lead repository.

How to identify when editing

Claims
M20: No navigation of its own; relies on onCreated/onCancel callbacks. Source, payer and attach-timing hold defaults in state but have no visible pickers. Name is the only required field.

#0014af-leadInbox

Leads

owneradmin
sub-viewadmin-financemounted: truenewAdmin close-out

Admin sees a "Leads" list of unconverted leads, newest first, including needs_info ones with badges. Taps a lead row to open it, or "New Lead" to create one. Action buttons are G1 sand buttons with tightened vertical spacing. Reached via nav drawer section "Sales & Marketing" > "Leads". Has loading, error and empty states.

Lets owners/admins triage incoming leads before they are converted into jobs.

How to identify when editing

Claims
M22: Navigation is purely callback-driven (onSelectLead, onCreateLead); New Lead is disabled if the host does not pass onCreateLead. No filters or search. Nothing hardcoded in the screen.

#0047af-timeOffQueue

Time Off

owneradmin
sub-viewadmin-financemounted: truenoneAncillary

Admin sees time-off requests: a pending queue and an Upcoming Blackouts list, with a read-only Blackout calendar below them. An "Add Blackout" button opens the blackout editor; each Upcoming row has a "Cancel" button. The calendar shows pending and approved blackouts on a Month view by default (Week is remembered on this device), with a picker to show All Techs or one tech. Pending requests are decided automatically.

Lets owners/admins review technician time-off requests and manage approved blackouts, which feed scheduling.

How to identify when editing

Claims
M35: No approve/deny actions: pending requests are decided by a database trigger. Add Blackout navigates via the onAddBlackout callback, which the host must wire to BlackoutEditorScreen.

#0040job-region-assign

Assign

owneradmintech
regionno modulemounted: trueassignedJob Detail

Admin-only Assign tab on the Job page: shows "Assign Technician" with eligible techs to pick, plus unassign; busy/error shown; "Reassign job?" WarningSheet (Cancel/confirm) when moving a Prem tech.

Lets an admin assign, reassign or unassign the technician (and Prem investigator) for a job, advancing it toward assigned status.

How to identify when editing

Claims
M50: Nothing notable; region renders only when isAdmin, so owner/tech roles listed in the row never see it. Row buttonLabels only lists Cancel.

Schedule

owneradmintech
regionno modulemounted: truescheduledJob Detail

Schedule #0058: admin panel on Job Detail for setting a job's schedule. Heading "Schedule #0058" with sand buttons Clear Schedule, Save and Cancel. A top band shows the assigned Tech and Prem Tech on the left and a Start Time day-timeline picker on the right. Lets an admin set or clear a job's scheduled start/end time from Job Detail (day-timeline Start Time picker, Quick start, End, Scheduled for, Estimated, with the #0011 calendar below), saving through JobRepository.updateDetails.

#0009jobs

owneradmintech
